clips.title: The story
paras: The Large Soran'ruk Fragment rests in Shadowfang Keep, far from the other shards. Its broken orb once held a disgraced demon of the Burning Legion.

Disgraced demons of the Burning Legion may be condemned to imprisonment in enchanted orbs. Mages and warlocks aligned with the Legion receive these vessels and draw on the fel forces trapped within. Even when an orb is shattered, its bound fiend's lingering essence still radiates power. Each fragment draws ambitious practitioners of shadow magic.

The orb of Soran'ruk was cracked into two halves long ago. Cultists elsewhere scattered one half into smaller pieces. A sorcerer in the cursed Shadowfang Keep claimed the larger half. The Shadowfang Darksouls carry the Large Soran'ruk Fragment, which holds the bound spirit until someone seeks to reforge the ancient vessel.
